LESSON: STORY TELLING.

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Story telling.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Story telling., part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which days do we like celebrating? 2. What activities do we do on our worship day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Story telling. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

flag, dances, and President’s speech).

• Citizenship: The learner demonstrates joy and happiness in celebrating Mashujaa Day in the role play which is a sign of

patriotism and citizenship.

• Communication and collaboration: The learner tells stories on how public holidays are celebrated while others listen.

• Creativity and imagination: Learner expresses own ideas and imaginations while role playing activities done on different

days of the week.
